evidence_note: 吴宽与沈周为挚友，沈周曾为吴宽父亲庄园作《东庄图册》。 | Wu Kuan and Shen Zhou were close friends; Shen Zhou painted the Dongzhuang Album for Wu Kuan's father's estate.
文徵明为吴宽学生，后以配祀身份供奉于尧峰山敬贤祠。 | Wen Zhengming was Wu Kuan's student and was later enshrined as his accompanying dedicatee at the Jingxian Shrine.
王鏊与吴宽同为苏州人、同朝为官，王鏊为吴宽撰神道碑，并同组五同会。 | Wang Ao, a fellow Suzhou native and court colleague, composed Wu Kuan's spirit-way inscription and co-founded the Five Commonalities Society.
吴宽与李东阳同为成化弘治间重要词臣。 | Wu Kuan and Li Dongyang were both leading literary officials of the Chenghua-Hongzhi era.
